text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'll overtake them, overtake them, overtake theeeem!!
—Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let you... Daaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—A swirling fighting spirit.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They've reached the fourth corner!
Now, which Umamusume will be the first to break away?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOAAAAH!" "Go, goooo!"
"Please, reach them...!" "Give it your allll!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Cheers. A roar. The earth trembling.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Hot, gh... So hot, hot, hot!!
Inside my body, my chest... my soul!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're having fun, aren't you? ...You want to keep going, right?
Further, even further ahead, faster than anyone else—!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (In that case... I will...!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... *pant*.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah, incredible. ...Incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(It was fun. My heart soared. I felt so fulfilled.
...More than ever before, the absolute most—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I felt as if I had been forgiven.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Was that girl Admire Vega?
Her late-race burst of speed is totally insane...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look, look at this feature article!
Her mother is a Double Tiara Umamusume.
She's definitely one to keep an eye on...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Crown her noble head with lotus and laurel――
Splendid as always, Ayabe-san! Bwa-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To garner this much attention for a debut race...!
Between her pedigree and raw potential,
everyone is bound to see she's on another level.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too...!!
Admire Vega returned to the underground tunnel amidst thunderous cheers.

Putting her immense talent and potential on full display,
she drew considerable attention, yet she herself
seemed completely unfazed—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...The next race.
We just need to decide where to set our goal, though."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To the highest echelon of racing...
...To the GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to aim for the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What is your perspective as a Trainer?

I think it through once more.
Her aptitude is undeniable. At 2,000m on turf, the distance suits her.
Above all—

Looking into Admire Vega's eyes as she gazed straight at me, I felt an unyielding resolve.
In that case...
choice_data_list: I agree. Let's aim for the Hopeful Stakes.
I agree. Let's aim for the Hopeful Stakes

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled.
...Next up is the Hopeful Stakes.

And so, our next target race was set:
the Hopeful Stakes, a Junior-tier GⅠ where
promising rising stars gather!
After a few hours on the Shinkansen leaving Kyoto Racecourse, we arrived back at the academy. ...Admire Vega barely showed any signs of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...About the training starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is the highest-class Junior GⅠ.
No... it's to win it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "So, put that much load on me. ...Don't you dare go easy on me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well then.
choice_data_list: Ah, take care on your way home—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Further ahead. To higher ground.
More and more brilliant glory, for that girl.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even more... boundless joy, just for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If I were to swallow even the star of hope...
Would you smile for me, I wonder—"
—...That was fun, wasn't it?

That was fun, wasn't it?
It was so, so very fun.
It's fun, isn't it, Big Sis—
